description: This survey describes household food, water and energy consumption in urban Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad, India. UFZ researchers and the Gokhale Institute of Politics and Economics conducted stratified, face-to-face interviews during January–March 2020. The article reports 1,872 household observations and 606 variables, including utility consumption, socioeconomic characteristics and responses to intermittent water supply. GESIS version 2.0.0 provides the cleaned CSV dataset and questionnaire with free registered-user access under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. The public browser page established these terms although the DOI registry omitted rights metadata. Coverage is cross-sectional, and household self-reports and a single season are limitations for dynamic demand modelling. Modellers could parameterise household agents or water-energy coping behaviour in demand simulations. model-epanet and platform-global-food-twin provide complementary physical-network and food-system resources requiring separate coupling. The prior DOI 10.7802/2730 is a previous version of this resource. No sign-in or household-data download was required or attempted.
